HELPER_AVAILABILITY_NOTE: Helper availability depends on whether the driver who accepts your haul has someone available to help — it's not guaranteed and can vary from load to load.
SUPPORT_HOURS: Phone support runs Monday-Sunday, 8 AM-5 PM PST. Email support is available 24/7, with replies typically within 24-48 hours depending on ticket volume — time-sensitive requests are prioritized.
DORM_MOVE_DATES: Fresno State's Fall 2026 move-in is Thursday, August 20, by scheduled appointment time. Move-out timing is typically mid-May — check Fresno State Housing's site closer to the date for the exact window.
CAMPUS_PARKING_RULES: Parking enforcement is relaxed on move-in day only — move vehicles to Lot P27 or Lot P30 right after unloading (P27 is the only lot allowing overnight resident parking). Never park on lawns or maintenance driveways. Outside move-in day, permits are required in all campus lots, 24/7.
LANDFILL_HOURS_FEES: American Avenue Disposal Site (18950 W. American Ave., Kerman): Monday-Friday 7am-3pm, Saturday 8am-2:30pm, closed Sunday. A minimum load (up to 640 lbs) runs $9.45; general refuse is $29.52/ton, effective July 2026.
CARTS_HOURS_FEES: Cedar Avenue Recycling & Transfer Station, 3457 S. Cedar Ave., Fresno: Monday-Friday 7am-5pm, Saturday 7am-2:30pm, closed Sunday. Per-load and per-ton fees vary by material — call (559) 233-1158 for the current rate before a load.
FRESNO_BULKY_SCHEDULE: Fresno's One-Time Bulky Item Pickup covers a single item once every 12 months, free, scheduled via 311 or (559) 621-2489 (confirmed within about a week). Fresno also runs the annual Operation Clean Up curbside event (free, up to 10 cubic yards — check your scheduled date at fresno.gov) and Free Dump Events at CARTS a few times a year with proof of address.
CLOVIS_BULKY_PROGRAM: Clovis's Community Clean-Up runs twice a year for single-family homes, included in existing trash service at no extra cost — find your pickup date at ClovisCA.gov/CommunityCleanUp. Items go curbside (not the side yard or alley) no more than two weeks ahead, by 6am on pickup day.
DRIVER_INSURANCE_MINIMUM: Every driver must carry additional insurance coverage specifically designed for rideshare and delivery drivers, on top of a standard personal auto policy — this is required to comply with local and state law, not optional.
PAYOUT_SCHEDULE: Drivers are paid weekly by default. A per-job instant payout is also available on request, for a sliding fee — see instant vs. weekly below.
INSTANT_PAY_FEE: Yes — request your payout immediately after a job is completed instead of waiting for the weekly payout, for a sliding fee based on that job's size and amount, deducted from the payout.
APPLY_TIMELINE: Driver verification and onboarding typically takes about 1-3 days in California, though it can vary based on factors like your location, tax information, and any special circumstances.
REAPPLICATION_COOLDOWN_POLICY: If your application is denied by Checkr, you can reapply after a 1-month cooling-off period. If you're denied a second time within 2 months of the first denial, the required cooling-off period extends to 6 months before you can reapply again.
COSTCO_PICKUP_INFO: Costco doesn't run a separate online-pickup counter for large items — for an in-warehouse purchase, the driver meets you near the exit/loading area where staff can help load bulky items straight from a cart. Large items bought online ship via home delivery instead of in-store pickup.
HOME_DEPOT_PICKUP_INFO: For an online order, check in at the marked Curbside Pickup spot near the entrance — but large items like lumber or full-size appliances are usually staged at the Pro Desk or a separate loading area instead. Confirm which applies to your order when you book.
LOWES_PICKUP_INFO: Bring your order confirmation and a photo ID matching the order — Lowe's holds ready orders for 7 days (extendable a few more) before canceling and refunding. Large items like lumber or appliances are typically staged at the Pro Desk or loading area rather than the standard pickup counter.
LIVING_SPACES_PICKUP_INFO: Check in at the Customer Pickup counter (open 12pm-8pm) with your printed receipt and photo ID matching the order. Items are held about 48 hours after your ready-for-pickup notice before being sent back to the distribution center.
ASHLEY_PICKUP_INFO: Call the store about an hour ahead so your order can be pulled for pickup, and bring photo ID matching the name on the order. Orders are typically held about 10 days after you're notified it's ready (7 days for floor-model or clearance pieces) before being returned to inventory.
BIG_LOTS_PICKUP_INFO: For an online order, call the store from the parking lot once you arrive and give your order barcode and ID for curbside pickup, available during daylight hours. Orders are typically held about 2 business days after the ready-for-pickup notice — call ahead to confirm your local store's pickup hours.
WALMART_PICKUP_INFO: Walmart's pickup tower and curbside pickup are built for smaller orders — large furniture and major appliances usually ship by large-item carrier delivery rather than in-store pickup. If you bought a large item in person rather than online, ask an associate to direct you to the loading area.
TARGET_PICKUP_INFO: For an eligible online order, use Drive Up and follow the app's check-in steps. Larger furniture that doesn't qualify for Drive Up is typically staged at Guest Services near the front of the store instead.
MATTRESS_FIRM_PICKUP_INFO: Call ahead to arrange pickup — Mattress Firm offers same-day "Take Home Today" for in-stock mattresses via curbside or in-store pickup. Ask the store about their specific ID and pickup-window requirements when you book, since these can vary by location.
FIRST_HAUL_PROMO: New customers get 20% off their first haul, automatically applied when you sign up with an email and phone number that haven't been used on a BoxHauls account before. Once the discount is redeemed, pricing returns to the standard rate — and that email, that phone number, or any combination of the two becomes ineligible for the first-haul discount going forward.
